events.description: Initialization of the 3D axes and the horizontal grid plane representing the propagation space.
events.clip_query: A 3D coordinate system with axes and a grid plane is displayed.

events.description: The semi-transparent Sugar Cylinder is rendered along the x-axis, representing the optically active medium.
events.clip_query: A semi-transparent cylinder is placed along the main axis of the 3D space.

events.description: An oscillating wave begins propagating along the x-axis, showing standard sinusoidal oscillation before entering the cylinder.
events.clip_query: A sinusoidal wave propagates dynamically along the axis.

events.description: The wave enters the cylinder and its polarization plane begins to twist continuously, forming a helical pattern.
events.clip_query: The propagating wave twists into a helical shape inside the cylinder.
